consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1988-04-15 show at Rosemont Horizon featured a unique and exciting performance, particularly highlighted by the rare Scarlet->Fire opener. Many reviewers praised the energy and overall quality of the show, despite some mixed feelings about specific songs and moments.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 40 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the show and highlighted its standout moments, there were also criticisms regarding the overall performance quality and comparisons to other shows, leading to a mixed sentiment.
